cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll keep this company working. No tickets sold means an uninterrupted rehearsal; this could be our best evening yet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The theatre's cancelled us. I'm asking for the deposit back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good move. You handle that, and we'll choose somewhere you actually enjoy playing. A fresh venue could do wonders for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've kept it. All we can afford is the bus home, and that's where I'm going.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll carry the scenery and come with you. Our first traveling rehearsal! You pick two lines you still enjoy; we'll try them quietly between stops and get home with a better scene.

reason: Have A embrace B homeward boundary and give B a small quiet rehearsal choice, increasing optimism through the actual bus solution while keeping cooperation voluntary.
